title: Juicy Russian Beef Papillote
description: A funky, adventurous Russian dish featuring tender beef, crunchy vegetables, and herbs, all wrapped in a flavorful papillote. Serve with a side of steamed vegetables for a well-rounded meal.
instructions: Season the beef strip loin with salt, black pepper, and thyme.
Heat canola oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Sear the beef strip loin for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Transfer the beef to a plate and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the sliced onion, minced garlic, chopped carrots, and chopped celery. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the rosemary sprigs and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Wrap the beef strip loin and the cooked vegetables in a large piece of parchment paper or aluminum foil, creating a papillote.
Place the papillote on a baking sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the beef is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
While the papillote is cooking, mix the lemon juice and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
After 15 minutes of cooking, brush the papillote with the lemon mixture.
Remove the papillote from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Slice the beef into thin strips and serve with the steamed vegetables and a drizzle of lemon juice.
Garnish with additional rosemary sprigs, if desired.
